messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: examples are not working - how-to debug
parts:
Dear All,

I have a problem with displaying graphs. Hopefully you can help me. 
I try to run the examples. I run:

> library(shiny)
> runExample("01_hello")

Listening on port 8100

On the web browser there is a grey underlay-ed background. There is also the "Hello Shiny!" and a slider where I can select a number between 0 and 1000. 
But there is no result, there is no graph.  

The same with runExample("02_text")
On the left side I can choose the dataset and the nuber. But on the right side there is only a grey small box without any text inside. Also the table below is not shown.


I run this version of R 

> version
               _

Any help would be nice.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: examples are not working - how-to debug
parts:
To see what's communicated between the server and client, you can set options(shiny.trace = TRUE) before running the app. You can also insert browser() or print() statements into your code.

(This all assumes that you managed to get httpuv to compile and install on Solaris, of course.)

Also, what browser are you using? It's possible that it's a browser issue.

-Winston

messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: Re: examples are not working - how-to debug
parts:
Dear Joe

Why shocked ? 
I am in the UNIX business since 29 years and I compiled a lot of stuff, which didn't compile at the first step. 
But this time I got some really useful tips from some forum I am really thanks-full. 
I am total new to R and its functionality. As systems administrator I try to support our colleagues with this product. 

Based on the information I found out to change src/Makevars I did it with a dirty hack. This is the diff: 

# diff .Makevars_orig .Makevars_20130716
9c9
< PKG_LIBS = `$(R_HOME)/bin/Rscript -e "Rcpp:::LdFlags()"` ./libuv/libuv.a ./http-parser/http_parser.o ./sha1/sha1.o ./base64/base64.o $(FRAMEWORK)
---
> PKG_LIBS = `$(R_HOME)/bin/Rscript -e "Rcpp:::LdFlags()"` ./libuv/libuv.a ./http-parser/http_parser.o ./sha1/sha1.o ./base64/base64.o -lsendfile $(FRAMEWORK)

I also changed a little bit src/libuv/src/unix/sunos.c

# diff sunos.c_orig .sunos.c_20130710
30a31
> #define SUNOS_NO_IFADDRS 1

But I am still fighting against the situation, that the examples are not showing any results and I don't get any warnings or error messages. 

Kind regards 
Hans
